Stated Claim / Post Context:
Illinois State trooper charged with sexually assault of a woman in Tinley Park

Actual Article Body:

Illinois State Police Trooper Douglas Lee, 54, of Tinley Park was ordered held in custody Saturday pending trial by Cook County Judge Shauna Boliker after being charged with sexual assault, according to court records.

The charges stem from an encounter in the early morning Aug. 2, 2025, and involved a victim who was unable to give knowing consent, according to a Tinley Park news release.

The Illinois State Police said Monday that Lee is on administrative leave without pay, and that state police are conducting an internal investigation.

Tinley Park detectives investigated Lee and presented evidence to the Cook County state’s attorney’s office, which approved the felony charge, according to the village.

Boliker wrote in her order that Lee “poses a real and present threat to the safety of any person, and woman in the community.”

Lee is alleged to have drugged the victim, taken her to a hotel and sexually assaulted her, according to Boliker’s order.

Lee is scheduled to appear again in court Tuesday morning at the Cook County courthouse in Bridgeview before Judge Linzey Jones.
